evidence_origin: Historical observation copied from the original pre-fix tool output; not rerun against old code after the fix
missing_metadata_reason: The original temporary reproduction printed behavior but did not retain a timestamp or gateway source hash; those values are not reconstructed
method: Start the gateway CLI as a subprocess against a synthetic loopback HTTP fixture using only synthetic test credentials
Connect and send complete HTTP headers including Content-Length, withholding the entire request body
Wait 0.1 seconds so the accepted handler blocks reading the body
Send SIGTERM to the gateway subprocess
Wait 0.2 seconds, observe the process still waiting for that handler and zero upstream calls
Send the withheld body; observe response, upstream calls, process exit and closed receipt
interpretation: Listener shutdown did not fence admission for already accepted handlers; a new upstream reservation could occur after SIGTERM
